GeneDef.label: petrifying gaze
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can freeze a victim solid with a look - alive but motionless, hunger and weariness held in perfect stasis, until the spell loosens days later.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Can petrify a victim with her gaze: the target is frozen - downed and unchanging - for two days.

GeneDef.label: malef corruption
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene remake the women they claim: a baseline victim rises as a dragonewt, and a dragon is blackened into a malef mirror of her seducer.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Women whose will breaks under her teasing are transformed: baselines into dragonewts, dragons into malef dragons.
